learning_outcomes.text: The student explains how a number of basic AI techniques work, and why they work.
The student assesses the relevance of these techniques for specific applications.
The student explains the connections between these techniques.
The student provides an overview of the AI and machine learning techniques covered.
The student selects the correct AI algorithm based on the problem statement and required complexity.
The student explains the relationship between the input data and the quality of the output of the AI application.

syllabus_topics: Introduction and overview of AI, including basic concepts such as training, inference, etc.
Machine Learning: classification, regression, decision trees, neural networks, deep learning, ensemble methods, best practices.
assessment_rules: The evaluation consists 100% of a final exam. The total grade for the second examination opportunity is calculated 100% based on the resit exam during the third examination period. For this course, there are no partial transfers.
bibliography: Slides and online material, provided via Canvas.
